recipes.name: Beef Wellington
recipes.description: Fillet in mushroom duxelles and ham, baked inside puff pastry.

steps.instruction: Sear fillet; brush mustard; cool completely.
Spread dry duxelles on ham; roll around beef; chill.
Wrap in pastry, egg-wash, chill.
Bake 200°C ~35 min (core 52°C); rest 15 min.

videos.videoTitle: Chef's Guide to Perfect Beef Wellington

recipes.name: Cottage Pie
recipes.description: Minced-beef gravy under buttery mash, baked golden.

steps.instruction: Brown mince; sweat veg; add paste and flour.
Add stock; simmer 30 min to thick gravy.
Top with mash; bake 190°C 35 min.

recipes.name: Roast Beef & Yorkshire Puddings
recipes.description: Sunday sirloin with dripping potatoes and towering puddings.

steps.instruction: Sear 220°C 20 min; roast 180°C to core 54-56°C.
Rest 30+ minutes.
Smoking dripping + cold batter = puddings 220°C ~20 min.

recipes.name: Beef Stew with Dumplings
recipes.description: Ale-braised beef under herbed suet-style dumplings.

steps.instruction: Brown beef; soften vegetables.
Paste, ale, stock; braise low 2 hours.
Dumplings on top: lid 20 min, open 10.

recipes.name: Beef Stew
recipes.description: Hearty chunks of beef slow-cooked with root vegetables in a rich gravy.

steps.instruction: Toss beef chunks in seasoned flour and brown in butter over high heat.
Add onion, celery, and cook until softened.
Stir in tomato paste, then pour in beef stock. Add thyme and bay leaf.
Add potatoes and carrots, bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook gently for 2 hours until the beef is tender.
Season to taste and serve hot.

videos.videoTitle: Classic Beef Stew Recipe For Dinner - Natasha's Kitchen

recipes.name: Cornish Pasty
recipes.description: Traditional crimped pastry filled with seasoned beef, potato, swede, and onion.

steps.instruction: Rub butter into flour until crumbly, then add cold water to form a dough. Chill for 30 minutes.
Mix diced beef, potato, swede, and onion with salt and pepper.
Roll out pastry into circles, place filling on one half.
Moisten edges, fold over, and crimp firmly along the side.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes, then reduce to 160°C for 30 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving.

videos.videoTitle: How to make a "PROPER" Cornish Pasty  (REAL Recipe)

recipes.name: Beef and Ale Pie
recipes.description: Slow-braised beef in ale gravy topped with a buttery pastry lid.

steps.instruction: Brown beef cubes in butter, set aside.
Cook onion, celery, and carrots until softened. Stir in flour.
Return beef, pour in ale and stock, add thyme and bay leaf.
Simmer gently for 1.5 hours until beef is tender and gravy thickened.
Pour into a pie dish and cover with pastry. Cut a steam hole.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until pastry is golden.

videos.videoTitle: Cooking the classic Steak and Ale Pie | Paul Hollywood’s Pies & Puds

recipes.name: Steak and Kidney Pie
recipes.description: Classic British pie with diced steak and kidneys in a savoury gravy.

steps.instruction: Coat beef and kidney in seasoned flour.
Brown in butter, add onion and cook until softened.
Add mushrooms, stock, worcestershire sauce, and thyme. Simmer for 1.5 hours.
Cool slightly and pour into a pie dish.
Top with pastry lid, brush with egg wash, and cut a steam hole.
Bake at 200°C for 30 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Roast Beef
recipes.description: Perfectly roasted joint of beef served with gravy and seasonal vegetables.

steps.instruction: Bring beef to room temperature and season generously.
Sear all sides in a hot oiled pan until browned.
Place on a bed of onions in a roasting tray. Toss vegetables in oil and arrange around the beef.
Roast at 220°C for 20 minutes, then reduce to 170°C for 30 minutes for medium.
Rest the beef for 20 minutes, loosely tented with foil.
Make gravy from the pan juices with beef stock and serve.

recipes.name: Braised Beef
recipes.description: Fork-tender beef slow-braised in red wine and herbs until meltingly soft.

steps.instruction: Season and sear beef brisket in olive oil until well browned all over. Set aside.
Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until golden.
Stir in garlic and tomato paste, cook for one minute.
Deglaze with red wine, then add stock and herbs.
Return beef, cover tightly, and braise at 160°C for 3 hours.
Slice beef and serve with the braising liquid reduced to a glossy sauce.

recipes.name: Beef Hash
recipes.description: Crispy pan-fried potatoes and leftover beef with onions and herbs.

steps.instruction: Heat beef dripping in a heavy-based pan over medium-high heat.
Add parboiled potatoes and cook without stirring until golden and crispy.
Add onion and bell pepper, cook until softened.
Stir in diced beef and worcestershire sauce, cook until piping hot.
Create a well and fry an egg until the white is set.
Serve immediately topped with chopped parsley.

recipes.name: Bangers Mash and Onion Gravy
recipes.description: Plump pork sausages piled on creamy mash with a generous ladle of onion gravy.

steps.instruction: Boil potatoes until tender, mash with butter and milk until smooth.
Cook sausages in a frying pan until browned all over and cooked through.
In the same pan, cook sliced onions slowly for 15 minutes until caramelised.
Sprinkle flour over onions, stir, then gradually add stock.
Add mustard and thyme, simmer until gravy thickens.
Pile mash onto plates, top with sausages, and ladle over onion gravy.

recipes.name: Beef Curry
recipes.description: Aromatic British-style beef curry with warming spices and tender meat.

steps.instruction: Cook rice according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat oil and brown beef pieces on all sides.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic, cook until fragrant.
Stir in curry powder, turmeric, and cumin, cook for one minute.
Add tomatoes and coconut milk, bring to a simmer.
Cook covered for 1.5 hours until beef is very tender. Serve over rice with fresh coriander.

recipes.name: Boiled Beef and Carrots
recipes.description: Traditional boiled beef joint served with tender carrots and suet dumplings.

steps.instruction: Place beef brisket in a large pan, cover with cold water, and bring to the boil.
Skim the surface, then add onion, bay leaf, parsley stalks, and seasoning.
Simmer gently for 2 hours, adding carrots in the last 40 minutes.
Mix flour, suet, and water to form dumpling dough. Shape into 4 balls.
Add dumplings to the pan for the final 20 minutes, covered with a lid.
Slice beef and serve with carrots, dumplings, and cooking liquor.

recipes.name: Beef Brisket
recipes.description: Low and slow oven-braised beef brisket with a sticky glaze and root vegetables.

steps.instruction: Season brisket generously and sear in hot oil until browned all over.
Place onions in the bottom of a roasting tin and set brisket on top.
Mix stock, ketchup, mustard, sugar, and worcestershire sauce. Pour over the brisket.
Arrange carrots and potatoes around the meat.
Cover tightly with foil and cook at 150°C for 4 hours.
Uncover for the last 30 minutes to brown. Rest, slice, and serve with vegetables and gravy.

recipes.name: Yorkshire Pudding
recipes.description: Crisp golden batter puddings with a light airy centre, perfect with roast dinners.

steps.instruction: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, and salt until smooth and lump-free.
Rest the batter in the fridge for at least 30 minutes.
Put a small cube of beef dripping in each hole of a muffin tin.
Heat the tin in a very hot oven at 220°C until the fat is smoking.
Quickly pour batter into each hole, filling halfway.
Bake for 20 minutes without opening the oven door until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Toad in the Hole
recipes.description: Sausages baked in a golden batter pudding with onion gravy on the side.

steps.instruction: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, and salt into a smooth batter. Rest for 30 minutes.
Brown sausages in a roasting tin with dripping at 220°C for 10 minutes.
Pour batter over the sausages and return to the oven for 25 minutes until risen and golden.
Meanwhile, caramelise sliced onions and make gravy with stock.
Serve the toad in the hole cut into portions with onion gravy.

recipes.name: Beef Tartare
recipes.description: Finely diced raw beef seasoned with capers, mustard, and egg yolk.

steps.instruction: Ensure beef fillet is very cold. Trim any sinew and dice finely by hand.
Mix beef with shallot, capers, cornichons, mustard, and worcestershire sauce.
Season with salt and pepper and form into a neat mound.
Make a small well in the centre and place the egg yolk on top.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve immediately with toast.

recipes.name: Roast Chicken Dinner
recipes.description: Classic Sunday roast chicken with Yorkshire pudding, roast potatoes and gravy.

steps.instruction: Parboil potatoes, drain and shake to roughen edges. Roast in hot fat until golden.
Season chicken leg with butter, sage, rosemary, and salt.
Place chicken and pigs in blankets on the roasting tray with potatoes.
Roast at 200°C for 45 minutes until chicken is golden and juices run clear.
Steam carrots and sprouts until tender.
Rest chicken for 10 minutes. Serve everything with gravy.

recipes.name: Chips
recipes.description: Thick-cut British chips, fluffy inside with a golden crispy exterior.

ingredients.name: maris piper potatoes
ingredients.note: peeled and cut into thick chips

steps.instruction: Cut potatoes into thick chips about 1.5cm wide.
Rinse in cold water and pat completely dry.
Heat dripping in a deep pan to 130°C.
Blanch chips for 8 minutes until soft but not coloured. Drain and cool.
Heat fat to 180°C and fry chips for 4 minutes until golden and crispy.
Drain, season with salt, and serve with malt vinegar.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.description: Charred tikka chicken in glossy spiced tomato cream.

steps.instruction: Grill marinated chicken until charred.
Bloom spices in butter; add passata; simmer 15 min.
Fold in chicken + cream; bubble 5 min.

recipes.name: Coronation Chicken
recipes.description: Cold curried creamy chicken with apricot - 1953 classic.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken; cool; shred chunky.
Fry curry paste briefly; cool; fold into mayo mix.
Combine all; chill before sandwiching.

recipes.name: Chicken & Leek Pie
recipes.description: Creamy chicken-leek filling under crisp puff pastry lid.

steps.instruction: Soften leeks; cook chicken through.
Make creamy sauce with mustard and tarragon; combine.
Fill dish; pastry lid; egg-wash; bake 200°C 35 min.

recipes.name: Sunday Roast Chicken
recipes.description: Herb-butter roast chicken with gravy - the centrepiece of the British Sunday table.

steps.instruction: Butter under and over skin; season boldly.
Roast 200°C then 180°C ~70 min, basting.
Rest 15 min; gravy from tray juices.

recipes.name: Roast Chicken
recipes.description: Whole roast chicken with crispy golden skin, roasted vegetables, and pan gravy.

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 200°C. Rub chicken all over with softened butter, lemon juice, and seasoning.
Stuff the cavity with lemon halves and herbs.
Toss vegetables in olive oil and arrange in a roasting tin.
Place chicken on top and roast for 50 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Rest the chicken for 15 minutes, loosely covered.
Make gravy from the pan juices with stock and flour.

recipes.name: Chicken Pie
recipes.description: Creamy chicken and vegetable filling under a flaky golden pastry lid.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken in stock until cooked, then shred. Reserve the cooking liquid.
Melt butter, cook onion and carrots until soft. Stir in flour.
Add stock gradually, cream, peas, shredded chicken, and thyme. Simmer until thickened.
Pour into a pie dish, cool slightly, and cover with pastry.
Brush with egg wash and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes until golden.
Scatter with parsley and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka
recipes.description: Yoghurt-marinated chicken chargrilled and served with mint raita.

steps.instruction: Mix yoghurt with all the spices, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, and salt.
Coat chicken chunks thoroughly in the marinade and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Thread onto skewers and cook under a hot grill for 12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Cook rice according to package instructions.
Mix mint with yoghurt for a quick raita.
Serve chicken tikka hot with rice and mint raita.

recipes.name: Chicken Curry
recipes.description: Mild and creamy British-style chicken curry with tender breast pieces.

steps.instruction: Cook rice according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat oil, brown diced chicken on all sides, and set aside.
Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until softened.
Add spices and cook for one minute until fragrant.
Add tomatoes and coconut milk, simmer for 10 minutes.
Return chicken and cook for another 15 minutes. Garnish with coriander and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Chasseur
recipes.description: French-inspired chicken in a tomato and mushroom hunter sauce with herbs.

steps.instruction: Season chicken thighs and brown skin-side down in a hot pan until golden. Remove.
In the same pan, cook shallots and garlic in butter until softened.
Add mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes until golden.
Stir in tomato paste, deglaze with white wine, and add stock and tomatoes.
Return chicken, add tarragon, cover and simmer for 35 minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with crusty bread or boiled potatoes.

recipes.name: Chicken Kiev
recipes.description: Breaded chicken breast filled with garlic butter that bursts when cut.

steps.instruction: Mix softened butter with minced garlic and chopped parsley. Roll into a log and freeze for 15 minutes.
Place butterflied chicken between cling film and pound to even thickness.
Place the garlic butter log in the centre and roll the chicken tightly around it.
Seal the edges well, then chill for 20 minutes.
Coat in flour, beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Shallow fry in hot oil for 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

recipes.name: Chicken with Leeks
recipes.description: Pan-fried chicken thighs braised with creamy leeks and white wine.

steps.instruction: Season chicken thighs and brown skin-side down in a hot pan until golden. Remove.
Melt butter and gently cook sliced leeks for 8 minutes until very soft.
Add thyme, deglaze with white wine, and reduce by half.
Add stock and cream, bring to a gentle simmer.
Return chicken, cover, and cook for 25 minutes until tender.
Stir in mustard, season, and garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Chicken Pot Pie
recipes.description: Rich creamy chicken and vegetable stew under a golden puff pastry crust.

steps.instruction: Poach diced chicken in stock until cooked. Remove and shred, reserving the liquid.
Melt butter, cook onion and carrots, then stir in flour.
Gradually add reserved stock and cream, stirring until smooth and thick.
Add chicken, peas, potatoes, and thyme. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Pour into an ovenproof dish, cool slightly, and top with puff pastry.
Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden.

recipes.name: Chicken a la King
recipes.description: Diced chicken in a creamy sauce with peppers, mushrooms, and herbs.

steps.instruction: Poach chicken breast in stock until cooked, then dice.
Melt butter and sauté onion, pepper, and mushrooms until softened.
Stir in flour, cook for one minute, then gradually add stock.
Add cream, sherry, and diced chicken. Simmer until thickened.
Season to taste and stir in parsley.
Serve hot over toast.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Salad
recipes.description: Grilled chicken breast over crisp romaine with parmesan, croutons, and Caesar dressing.

steps.instruction: Season chicken breast and grill until cooked through. Rest and slice.
Toss bread cubes in olive oil and garlic, bake at 200°C for 8 minutes for croutons.
Blend anchovy, egg yolk, mustard, lemon juice, and oil for the dressing.
Toss romaine with dressing, croutons, and shaved parmesan.
Top with sliced grilled chicken.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Chicken Liver Pate
recipes.description: Silky smooth chicken liver pate with butter and thyme, served with toast.

steps.instruction: Trim chicken livers and pat dry.
Melt half the butter and cook shallot and garlic until soft.
Increase heat and cook livers for 2 minutes per side until browned outside but pink inside.
Add thyme and brandy, cook for 1 minute.
Transfer to a blender and blitz until very smooth, adding remaining butter.
Season, press into ramekins, chill for 2 hours. Serve with toast.

recipes.name: Chicken Casserole
recipes.description: One-pot braised chicken with white beans, tomatoes, and herby breadcrumbs.

steps.instruction: Season chicken and brown in olive oil in a casserole dish.
Add onion, celery, and garlic, cook until softened.
Stir in tomatoes, beans, stock, and thyme. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook at 170°C for 40 minutes until chicken is tender.
Mix breadcrumbs with parsley and scatter over the top.
Return to the oven for 10 minutes until the topping is crisp.

recipes.name: Chicken Sandwich
recipes.description: Classic British chicken sandwich with lettuce, mayo, and crusty white bread.

steps.instruction: Cook chicken breast until golden and cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Spread mayonnaise on both slices of bread.
Layer lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and sliced chicken.
Season with black pepper and close the sandwich.
Cut in half and serve.

recipes.name: Tandoori Chicken
recipes.description: Spice-marinated chicken baked until charred and smoky with a yoghurt-based marinade.

steps.instruction: Score slashes in chicken thighs to help the marinade penetrate.
Mix yoghurt with all spices, garlic, ginger, lemon juice, and salt.
Coat chicken thoroughly in the marinade and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
Cook rice according to package instructions.
Grill chicken on high heat for 8 minutes per side until lightly charred.
Serve with rice, lime wedges, and a side salad.

videos.videoTitle: TANDOORI CHICKEN | TANDOORI CHICKEN IN OVEN | TANDOORI CHICKEN RECIPE

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka British
recipes.description: British-Indian chicken tikka

steps.instruction: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices.
Refrigerate for 2 hours.
Grill or roast until charred.
Serve with naan and rice.

recipes.name: Bubble & Squeak
recipes.description: Crisp fried potato-and-cabbage cakes from Sunday leftovers.

steps.instruction: Mix mash, cabbage, onion; season; shape cakes.
Chill 20 minutes to firm.
Fry medium-hot until deep gold both sides.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Cheese
recipes.description: Tender florets under molten cheddar roux sauce, grilled bubbling.

steps.instruction: Blanch florets 5 minutes; drain well.
Make cheese sauce; combine in dish.
Gratinée 200°C ~20 min until spotted brown.

recipes.name: Welsh Rarebit
recipes.description: Ale-cheese molten toast - Britain's superior cheese-on-toast.

steps.instruction: Make roux; add ale; melt in cheese off heat with yolk.
Season boldly; cool slightly.
Spread thick on toast; grill until blistered.

videos.videoTitle: Perfect Welsh Rarebit & Chilli Jam | Jamie Oliver

recipes.name: Leek & Potato Soup
recipes.description: Two-vegetable velvet soup, best with crusty bread.

steps.instruction: Sweat leeks and onion gently without color.
Add potatoes + stock; simmer 25 min.
Blend half (or all) smooth; season.

recipes.name: Vegetable Curry
recipes.description: Hearty mixed vegetable curry in a spiced tomato and coconut sauce.

steps.instruction: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Heat oil and cook onion until softened.
Add garlic, ginger, and spices. Cook for one minute.
Add potatoes, cauliflower, tomatoes, and coconut milk. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Serve over rice with fresh coriander.

recipes.name: Jacket Potato
recipes.description: Fluffy baked potato with a crispy skin, served with classic fillings.

steps.instruction: Scrub the potato and pierce several times with a fork.
Rub with olive oil and salt, then bake at 200°C for 1 hour until the skin is crispy.
Cut open the top and fluff the inside with a fork.
Add butter and let it melt into the fluffy centre.
Top with heated baked beans and grated cheese.
Finish with sour cream and spring onion.

recipes.name: Ploughman's Lunch
recipes.description: A rustic board of farmhouse cheese, pickles, bread, apple, and salad.

steps.instruction: Cut a generous wedge of farmhouse cheese and place on a board.
Add a crusty bread roll and butter.
Arrange pickled onions, chutney, and celery sticks alongside.
Slice apple and add to the board.
Add a handful of crisp lettuce leaves.
Serve as a rustic sharing platter.

recipes.name: Vegetable Soup
recipes.description: Hearty homemade soup brimming with seasonal vegetables in a savoury broth.

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil and sauté onion, celery, and leek for 5 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes, cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, add bay leaf, thyme, and tomato paste.
Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Add peas and cook for 5 more minutes.
Season and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Creamy arborio rice stirred with wild mushrooms, parmesan, and thyme.

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil and sauté onion and garlic until softened.
Add mushrooms and cook until golden.
Stir in rice and cook for 2 minutes until translucent at the edges.
Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring and waiting until absorbed each time. Continue for 18 minutes.
Stir in butter, parmesan, and thyme. Season and garnish with parsley.

recipes.name: Tomato Soup
recipes.description: Velvety smooth roasted tomato soup with a hint of basil and cream.

steps.instruction: Toss halved tomatoes with olive oil, salt, and sugar. Roast at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add roasted tomatoes and stock. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until very smooth and pass through a sieve if desired.
Stir in cream and season to taste.
Serve hot with torn basil leaves.

recipes.name: Cheese on Toast
recipes.description: Thick slices of toast topped with melted cheddar, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce.

steps.instruction: Toast bread on one side until golden.
Butter the toasted side lightly.
Spread a thin layer of mustard on each slice.
Pile grated cheese on top and add a few dashes of worcestershire sauce.
Grill under a hot element for 4 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and golden.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Colcannon
recipes.description: Creamy Irish-style mashed potato with buttery cabbage and spring onion.

steps.instruction: Boil potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes. Drain well.
Steam or boil shredded cabbage for 5 minutes until tender. Drain and squeeze dry.
Mash potatoes with butter and milk until smooth.
Fold in the cooked cabbage and sliced spring onions.
Season generously with salt and pepper.
Serve with an extra knob of butter on top.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Shepherd's Pie
recipes.description: Hearty lentil and vegetable filling topped with creamy mashed potato.

steps.instruction: Cook lentils in vegetable stock until tender, about 25 minutes.
Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened.
Add tomato paste, tomatoes, worcestershire sauce, and thyme. Cook for 5 minutes.
Combine with cooked lentils and peas. Transfer to a baking dish.
Boil and mash potatoes with butter and milk. Season well.
Spread mash over the filling and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden.

recipes.name: Baked Beans on Toast
recipes.description: Classic British comfort: hearty baked beans on buttered toast.

steps.instruction: Pour baked beans into a saucepan and heat gently for 5 minutes.
Stir in a little ketchup and mustard for extra flavour.
Toast the bread until golden.
Butter the toast generously.
Pour the hot beans over the buttered toast.
Season with white pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Bubble and Squeak
recipes.description: Leftover vegetable patty pan-fried until crispy

steps.instruction: Mix mashed potato with cooked cabbage.
Add onion and season.
Form into patties.
Pan-fry in butter until golden.

recipes.name: Vegetable Curry British
recipes.description: Mild British-style vegetable curry

steps.instruction: Sauté onion and garlic.
Add curry powder and vegetables.
Pour in coconut milk.
Simmer until tender, serve with rice.

recipes.name: Ploughman's Lunch Platter
recipes.description: Traditional cheese and pickle platter

steps.instruction: Arrange cheese on a board.
Add bread, pickle, and pickled onions.
Include lettuce and apple.
Serve with ale.

recipes.name: London Fog Latte
recipes.description: Earl Grey tea latte with vanilla

steps.instruction: Steep Earl Grey in hot water.
Steam milk with vanilla.
Combine tea and steamed milk.
Sweeten to taste.

recipes.name: Parsnip Soup
recipes.description: Creamy roasted parsnip soup

steps.instruction: Roast parsnips and onion.
Blend with stock until smooth.
Heat and add cream.
Season with thyme and serve.

recipes.name: Bangers and Onion Gravy
recipes.description: Pork sausages with caramelized onion gravy

steps.instruction: Brown sausages in a pan.
Caramelize sliced onions in butter.
Add stock and thyme.
Simmer gravy and serve with sausages and mash.

recipes.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
recipes.description: Date-sponge drenched in warm toffee sauce with cream.

ingredients.name: Toffee Sauce (dates syrup + cream + butter + muscovado)

steps.instruction: Blend softened dates into sponge batter; bicarb for darkness.
Bake individual puddings 180°C ~22 min.
Simmer toffee sauce; flood puddings; serve with cream.

videos.videoTitle: How to Make Individual Sticky Toffee Pudding Cakes

recipes.name: Eton Mess
recipes.description: Crushed meringue, strawberries and whipped cream in glorious disorder.

steps.instruction: Macerate half the strawberries; crush into sauce.
Fold cream with both berries and crushed meringue.
Layer into glasses; serve immediately.

recipes.name: Bread Pudding
recipes.description: Spiced baked pudding of stale bread, dried fruit, custard, and warming spices.

steps.instruction: Soak torn bread in milk for 15 minutes until softened.
Mix in egg, melted butter, caster sugar, dried fruit, and spices.
Press into a buttered baking dish.
Sprinkle demerara sugar on top.
Bake at 180°C for 35 minutes until set and golden.
Serve warm with custard or cream.

recipes.name: Trifle
recipes.description: Layered dessert of sponge, fruit, custard, and whipped cream in a glass.

steps.instruction: Arrange sponge cubes in the bottom of a glass or dish.
Drizzle sherry over the sponge and spoon over raspberry jam.
Layer sliced strawberries and raspberries on top.
Pour over cold custard and spread evenly.
Top with whipped cream and scatter with toasted almonds.
Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.name: Treacle Tart
recipes.description: Golden syrup and lemon zest baked in a buttery shortcrust pastry shell.

steps.instruction: Line a tart tin with pastry and blind bake for 10 minutes at 190°C.
Warm golden syrup gently until fluid.
Mix in breadcrumbs, lemon zest, lemon juice, melted butter, and beaten egg.
Pour filling into the pastry case.
Bake at 190°C for 25 minutes until set and lightly golden.
Allow to cool slightly and serve with cream.

recipes.name: Spotted Dick
recipes.description: Steamed suet pudding studded with currants and served with hot custard.

steps.instruction: Mix flour, suet, and sugar. Stir in currants and lemon zest.
Add milk gradually to form a soft dough.
Roll into a log shape and wrap in greaseproof paper and foil, twisting the ends.
Steam for 1.5 hours, adding more water to the pan as needed.
Unwrap, slice, and serve hot with warm custard.

recipes.name: Bread and Butter Pudding
recipes.description: Layered slices of buttered bread with raisins baked in a vanilla custard.

steps.instruction: Butter bread slices and cut in half diagonally.
Arrange overlapping in a buttered dish, tucking raisins between the slices.
Whisk egg, milk, sugar, and vanilla together.
Pour the custard over the bread, press down and let soak for 20 minutes.
Dust with nutmeg and cinnamon, bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until golden and set.
Dust with icing sugar and serve warm.

recipes.name: Syllabub
recipes.description: Light and airy whipped cream sweetened with white wine and lemon.

steps.instruction: Whip the cream until it just begins to thicken.
Add sugar, lemon zest, lemon juice, and white wine.
Continue whipping until the mixture holds soft, airy peaks.
Spoon into glasses or serving dishes.
Grate fresh nutmeg on top.
Chill for 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Fruit Fool
recipes.description: Lightly whipped cream folded with puréed seasonal fruit and a touch of sugar.

steps.instruction: Blend half the raspberries with sugar into a smooth purée.
Whip the cream with vanilla until soft peaks form.
Fold the raspberry purée gently through the cream, keeping a ripple effect.
Spoon into glasses.
Top with the remaining whole raspberries and crushed meringue if using.
Chill for 20 minutes and serve.

recipes.name: Jam Roly-Poly
recipes.description: Suet pastry spread with jam and rolled, steamed or baked until sticky.

steps.instruction: Mix flour, suet, and sugar. Add milk to form a soft dough.
Roll out into a rectangle about 1cm thick.
Spread jam evenly over the dough, leaving a border.
Roll up tightly from the long side like a Swiss roll.
Wrap in greased foil and steam for 1.5 hours.
Serve hot with custard.

recipes.name: Cornish Pasty Traditional
recipes.description: Classic beef and swede pastry from Cornwall

steps.instruction: Dice beef, potato, swede, and onion.
Season and fill pastry.
Crimp the edges.
Bake at 190C for 45 minutes.
